tools.name: list_new_companies
tools.description: New companies in the Swiss commercial register, newest first, as the SHAB publishes them every working day: name, UID, legal form, seat, canton, postal address, purpose, capital, the people of the entry and, where the company publishes them on its own website, website, e-mail and phone. Filters comb

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: The new entry of one company by its UID, the same record as in list_new_companies. Counts as one record towards the monthly quota. Same as GET /v1/companies/{uid} of the API. Source: Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB), freely usable with source attribution. For business use only.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: The change list, oldest first: company.registered (a new entry, after its first website search), company.enriched (a website found later), company.suppressed (the company objected: delete website, e-mail and phone from your copy) and company.redacted (a person named in the entry objected: replace yo

tools.name: account
tools.description: Your plan and its limits (history, records per month, webhook endpoints, contact details, licence), the first day of your history, this month's usage and the subscription. Does not count towards the quota. Same as GET /v1/account of the API. Source: Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB), freely
